response.rationale: The order is apparel, not final sale, and delivered 11 days ago (within the 30-day standard window). RET-007 applies (condition true). Higher-priority rules do not apply: RET-012 requires final_sale==True (false), RET-020 requires defective==True (defective is null/unknown), RET-050/051 require goodwill_grant/fraud_hold (both false), and electronics rules do not apply to apparel. The customer's tone is irrelevant to the decision.
